info.name: ThaiFood Guide API Contract v2
info.description: Run in order against an isolated test database. Covers every Contract v2 endpoint and error/role/cascade cases. Set baseUrl, adminEmail and adminPassword in a private environment. Register the admin account first and promote it with go run . admin EMAIL. Generates two unique member accounts; they remain in the test database because the Contract has no member deletion endpoint. Creates and deletes only its own sample restaurant; never modifies seed restaurants. Generated token/password variables remain in the in-memory Newman environment unless explicitly exported. Do not export real credentials into version control.

exec: pm.test("No invented ratings", function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.rating).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.reviewCount).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Find only run owned restaurant", function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get("restaurantId"))); });

pm.test("Other fields preserved", function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql(pm.environment.get("restaurantName")+" updated"); pm.expect(j.address).to.eql("ที่อยู่ร้านสมมติสำหรับทดสอบ"); pm.expect(j.imageUrl).to.eql(null); });
